QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` is not enabled in `include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h`. ... `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` and `MBEDTLS_THREADING_ALT` are both commented out (lines 2185, 2196).
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The item requires both threading macros (THREADING_C and THREADING_PTHREAD) undefined. The answer says THREADING_C is "not enabled" and lists PTHREAD and ALT as commented out. That covers a different pair, and it never states that a default build defines neither of the two.
